grammar_title: 主语从句(Subject Clauses):that 引导 · 连接代词/副词引导 · it 作形式主语
source: 人教版2019选择性必修一 Unit 3 主语从句。铁律:that 不充当成分(从句不缺主宾)→ that;从句缺主语/宾语 → what/who;if 不引导主语从句(用 whether);wh- 词在从句中充当成分。句子围绕公园/自然主题,答案唯一。

points.point: that 引导主语从句(that 只起连接、不充当成分)
points.overview: 从句结构完整、不缺主语或宾语,只需要一个不充当成分的连接词时,用 that。如 That he survived the storm is a miracle.

points.point: 连接代词/副词引导主语从句(wh- 词在从句中充当成分)
points.overview: 从句缺主语/宾语用 what/who;表'是否'用 whether(不用 if);表原因/方式用 why/how。该词在从句里充当成分。

points.point: it 作形式主语,真正的从句主语后置
points.overview: 用 it 作形式主语、把从句移到句末:陈述事实 that;'谁'用 who;'是否'用 whether(句首 it 时不用 if)。

questions.stem: ____ Sarek became a national park in 1909 is well known to visitors.
questions.explanation: 从句 'Sarek became a national park in 1909' 结构完整、不缺主宾,只需连接词 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the Sami still follow their reindeer each spring surprises many tourists.
questions.explanation: 从句完整(主谓宾齐全)→ 用不充当成分的 that;if 不引导主语从句。

questions.stem: ____ no roads cross the park makes it hard to reach.
questions.explanation: 从句 'no roads cross the park' 完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the ice melted thousands of years ago is shown by the glaciers left behind.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: ____ all new building is banned inside the park protects its natural state.
questions.explanation: 从句 'all new building is banned…' 完整 → that;if 不能引导主语从句。

questions.stem: ____ the writer felt blessed in such a wild place is clear from the passage.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the park covers a vast area means animals have plenty of space.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → 连接词 that。

questions.stem: ____ Disneyland can be found in several parts of the world is true.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that;不可用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the Sami used reindeer for food, tools and clothes is part of their history.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ a ban on hunting helped the tigers recover has been proved by the numbers.
questions.explanation: 从句 'a ban on hunting helped…' 完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the wetland produces clean water and oxygen is widely recognised.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that;if 不引导主语从句。

questions.stem: ____ the sun never sets there in summer makes the days feel endless.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the new park is four times larger than the old one pleased the scientists.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ visitors must carry all their own food makes the hike harder.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that;不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the park connects with Russia's reserves gives the animals more room.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the Sami are allowed to keep their traditional life is stated in the rules.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ Dollywood celebrates southeastern culture is clear to every visitor.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that;不可用 if。

questions.stem: ____ trees grow right in the shallows makes the wetland special.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the candy is made the same way as 150 years ago is a rare experience.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the park stays natural and beautiful is what everyone hopes for.
questions.explanation: 从句完整 → that;if 不引导主语从句。

questions.stem: ____ matters most in a national park is the protection of nature.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(__ matters most)→ what 充当主语。

questions.stem: ____ we visit Sarek or not depends on the weather and our supplies.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、主语从句句首 → whether(不用 if)。

questions.stem: ____ designed the wetland park kept human impact to a minimum.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语、指人'无论谁'→ whoever。

questions.stem: ____ the Sami left the mountains is easy to understand once you know the cold.
questions.explanation: 表原因、从句缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: ____ the park attracts so many tourists is its breathtaking beauty.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(__ attracts…)→ what 作主语。

questions.stem: ____ the reindeer survive the long winter amazes scientists every year.
questions.explanation: 表方式'如何'、从句不缺主宾 → how。

questions.stem: ____ the rangers find first will be marked on the map.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(find __)、'无论什么'→ whatever。

questions.stem: ____ the old park was too small worried the local scientists.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that(此处对照:from句不缺成分则用 that)。

questions.stem: ____ the tigers go to hunt covers a very large area of forest.
questions.explanation: 表地点、从句缺地点状语 → where。

questions.stem: ____ we should develop a place like Sarek is still under discussion.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、句首主语从句 → whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the Sami eat for breakfast often includes dried reindeer meat.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(eat __)→ what 作宾语。

questions.stem: ____ first set up the reserve cared deeply about the rare animals.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: ____ the writer chose to camp alone shows his love of the wild.
questions.explanation: 表原因、从句不缺主宾 → why。

questions.stem: ____ makes Dollywood unique is its traditional southeastern culture.
questions.explanation: 从句缺主语(__ makes…)→ what。

questions.stem: ____ the park will open the new trail this year has not been decided.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、句首主语从句 → whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: ____ the ice once covered these mountains can still be seen in the glaciers.
questions.explanation: 从句完整、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: ____ the designers were most worried about was the impact on wildlife.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(worried about __)→ what。

questions.stem: ____ the tigers' numbers rose after 2015 is something the rules explain.
questions.explanation: 表原因、从句不缺主宾 → why。

questions.stem: ____ the wetland keeps so many birds and fish lies in its clean water.
questions.explanation: 表原因、从句完整 → why。

questions.stem: ____ you can do at the ocean park ranges from rides to dolphin shows.
questions.explanation: 从句缺宾语(can do __)→ what。

questions.stem: It is important ____ we protect parks for future generations.
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语、真正主语为完整从句、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It doesn't matter ____ wins the design competition for the new park.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It is still unknown ____ the new trail will open this summer.
questions.explanation: it 作形式主语、表'是否'→ whether(此处不用 if)。

questions.stem: It is a miracle ____ the rare tigers have come back at all.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It is not clear ____ banned the first hunting in the area.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It remains a question ____ such a wild place should be developed.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、it 形式主语 → whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: It is amazing ____ the sun never sets there during the summer months.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It is up to the rangers ____ marks the new route on the park map.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It is doubtful ____ many more roads should be built near the reserve.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、it 形式主语 → whether。

questions.stem: It is true ____ the Sami have lived in this territory for centuries.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It is unclear ____ named the park after the nearby mountain.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It is uncertain ____ the wetland can stay clean as the city grows.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、it 形式主语 → whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: It is well known ____ the park bans all new development inside its boundaries.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It does not matter ____ first discovered the hidden valley.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It is still being discussed ____ tourists should be allowed to camp here.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、it 形式主语 → whether。

questions.stem: It is clear ____ the writer thinks the hard hiking is worth it.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It is hard to say ____ designed the underwater corridor at the park.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。

questions.stem: It is not yet decided ____ the park will host the fountain show again.
questions.explanation: 表'是否'、it 形式主语 → whether,不用 if。

questions.stem: It is wonderful ____ children can ride and learn about nature at the park.
questions.explanation: it 形式主语、陈述事实 → that。

questions.stem: It is anyone's guess ____ will win the prize at the park's photo contest.
questions.explanation: 真正主语从句缺主语、指人 → who。
